comparison.objective: Inspect opaque cases and return an instrument only to the empty one; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1159 tests lid opening, wrist-camera inspection, carrying, placement, and reclosing; candidate tests precision tool engagement and rotary force control.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1159 requires placement in the vacant case and all lids seated, with occupied-case placement latched to zero; finer thresholds are absent and no spec versions exist. Candidate has dynamic stopping gates.
comparison.reason: Inspection-before-placement is unrelated to adjustment-and-lock commissioning.
